# Hit the Line

> Static English-language football statistics reference: how often a team goes over a line on corners, cards, total goals and both teams to score. Every page is plain HTML with the answer in the heading, dated with the data date.

## Sections

- Team pages: `/<league>/<team>/<metric>/` (corners, cards, goals, btts), for example `/championship/leeds/corners/`. One team, one metric: every line as k of n games, home and away split, by half, last matches.
- League summaries: `/<league>/corners/`, `/<league>/cards/`, `/<league>/goals/`, `/<league>/btts/`. Every team against every line.
- Streaks: `/<league>/streaks/`. Current runs over or under a line.
- Rounds: `/<league>/round/<n>/`. Per matchweek: runs started and ended, biggest movers in share over the line, matches with most corners and cards. `/<league>/round/` points to the latest.

## Notes

- Leagues: 2. Bundesliga, Belgian Pro League, Bundesliga, Championship, La Liga, Ligue 1, Ligue 2, Premier League, Primeira Liga, Serie A.
- Each page shows "Data as of YYYY-MM-DD"; matches with data defects are not published.
- Statistics only, no gambling content, no tracking.
- Sitemap: https://hittheline.com/sitemap.xml
